application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/03153/FUL: tree protection plan (4), construction traffic management plan (6), dust management plan (7) and non-road mobile machinery (8) in respect of redevelopment of site by erection of 2-storey dwelling house with habitable loft space, one front and two rear dormers, side roof lights, raised rear patio, new vehicular access, hardstanding, boundary treatments and associated landscaping and refuse and cycle storage.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are sufficient to satisfy the discharge of tree protection plan (4), construction traffic management plan (6), dust management plan (7) and non-road mobile machinery (8) conditions of permission ref: 25/03153/FUL and accordingly shall be approved.
